name: tars
description: TARS and its extensions: persistent memory for coding agents, and the capabilities that plug into it.

plugins.name: tars
plugins.description: Give your coding agent a memory it writes itself. Creates a git-backed identity, memory and protocol repo, wires it into every Claude Code and Codex session, and keeps it updated without ever overwriting what you wrote.

plugins.name: people-memory
plugins.description: A private people graph that gives your agent durable memory of everyone you know. MCP tools to search, remember and connect people, plus skills that record them during ordinary conversation. Postgres behind it, self-hostable.
